authorization.precedence: Parent/Astra approved the exact metadata contract; iteration11-plan.json revision4 is now aligned. The user requested source application artwork, not these technical size and encoding choices.
authorization.contractConflict: Resolved by plan revision4: sourceAppName <=80 Unicode scalars; sourceAppIconPng is a96x96 PNG <=16384 bytes /21848 canonical Base64 characters. No source change was needed.
authorization.visibilityFollowup: Parent relayed Astra approval for MAIN+LAUNCHER query only after live package-visibility failure. No broad query or enumeration.

sourceAppName.sanitization: Remove ISO controls, Unicode format controls, line/paragraph separators and lone surrogates; truncate at a scalar boundary and trim whitespace. Omit empty label.

sourceAppIconPng.encoding: Canonical standard Base64 with padding and no line breaks
sourceAppIconPng.format: Static PNG from native PackageManager application drawable; no notification images, avatars or network.

wireContract.fallback: Measure whole encoded envelope UTF8 length against existing65536 limit; drop optional icon first, then optional label by returning original envelope. Preserve original text and action fields.
wireContract.removals: No collection or decoration for removed=true,call.ended or outbound commands.
wireContract.consumerHandoff: Parent/Terra must consume exact field sourceAppIconPng with96px/16384byte/21848character bounds and80-scalar label. No extra platform/phone-name field; phone badge and paired phone label remain Mac-owned.

implementation: Small NotificationArtwork helper reads only the notification source package through PackageManager.getApplicationInfo/getApplicationLabel/getApplicationIcon; no package enumeration, cross-profile lookup, permissions, cache or network.
Native rendering uses a fixed96x96 ARGB bitmap, PNG encoding, post-encoding byte cap, restores drawable bounds and recycles bitmap. Lookup/render failures omit optional decoration.

Listener decorates only after mapper returns and ReplyDispatchLock.serialized has exited, while session status is READY. No new asynchronous suspension, reply capability mutation or authorization branch. Existing queue/session guards remain.
NotificationMapper remains unchanged: existing package/key/token/flags and tombstones are preserved.
Durable message sanitization additionally strips sourceAppIconPng; existing replyToken stripping,canReply=false and requiresAck=false remain. Label is retained without persisting bulky icons.

redactionReview.metadataToString: Reports presence booleans only, no name or image data.
redactionReview.existingUtility: Android PrivacyRedactor.redact and Swift PayloadPolicy.redact omit sourceAppIconPng from their sensitive-key sets. Searches of android/src/main and macos/Sources found their definitions but no production callers. No diagnostic forwarded-payload dump was found in the inspected notification path; no redaction source change was made.
redactionReview.limit: The existing redactors would retain the icon if called; they are not called by the inspected production sources.

coverage: Control removal and80-scalar truncation including supplementary emoji.
Independent label/render failure fallback and16384/16385-byte limit,canonical Base64 size/no-newlines.
Original envelope identity/reply fields preserved; excluded events do not invoke metadata loader.
Actual serialized whole-envelope boundary drops icon then name without modifying original fields.
Outbox replay removes icon/reply token,keeps label/package/key and remains non-actionable.
limitations: JVM helper tests inject source providers; native PackageManager lookup,Drawable/Bitmap rendering and real96x96 PNG output are source-reviewed,not platform-executed. Synthetic byte arrays test encoding bounds,not PNG decoder validity.
No live NotificationListener lock/thread scheduling or permission-revocation race test added; production wiring is inspected only.
No native Mac presentation,phone badge or reply roundtrip proof from this lane.
No build/compile/test pass claimed until parent gate.
